overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that the presence of "all-team-models" in a key's model list was sufficient to skip model access checks, without considering whether the key actually belonged to a team (had a team_id).
why_it_breaks: The original code skipped the model-level check whenever "all-team-models" appeared in valid_token.models, regardless of whether the key had a team_id. After PR #29746 fixed get_key_models to return an empty model list for teamless keys with all-team-models, the two call-path functions (_enforce_key_and_fallback_model_access and can_key_call_resolved_model) still unconditionally skipped their model checks on seeing the sentinel. This meant teamless keys with all-team-models retained unrestricted model access despite the earlier fix that was supposed to deny them. The fix adds `and valid_token.team_id is not None` to both conditions so that only team-owned keys can skip the check; teamless keys now fall through to can_key_call_model which correctly denies access via the unresolved sentinel.
